_comment_overview: Pipeline Configuration: Central control parameters, tolerances, and model configurations for AP Intelligent Processing Pipeline.
_comment_expected_invoice_count: Expected batch size. Ingest gate (src/ingest.py) verifies exact count matches before processing.
_comment_llm: Local LLM settings for Ollama runtime used across extraction (src/extract_ai.py), forensic impostor analysis (src/duplicates.py), and plain-language reasoning (src/enrich.py, src/decide.py).
_comment_verification: Arithmetic authority tolerances used in src/validate_extract.py. Line math (subtotal + VAT) must reconcile to within money_tolerance (EUR 0.01).
_comment_vendor_match: Difflib SequenceMatcher ratio threshold for fuzzy vendor name matching against vendor_master.csv in src/vendor_match.py.
_comment_duplicates: Duplicate detection settings for R5b (historic) and R5a (batch semantic) in src/duplicates.py. amount_tolerance_pct and date_window_days govern R5b; cosine_threshold, quantity_match_threshold, and evidence_floor govern R5a. embedding_backend auto switches to sentence-transformers if installed, else char4gram-cosine.
_comment_decide: If true, generates reviewer rationales using Ollama for non-CLEAR invoices in src/decide.py.
_comment_enrichment: If true, drafts plain-language exception notes and reviewer action messages in src/enrich.py.
